description.text:
The deck that won the Senior Division of the 2024 World Championships, the most played deck at that year's event. Regidrago VSTAR's Apex Dragon uses the attacks of any Dragon-type Pokémon in the discard pile, such as Dragapult ex, Hisuian Goodra VSTAR, Giratina VSTAR and Kyurem. The 2024 World Championships were held at the Hawai'i Convention Center in Honolulu from 16 to 18 August 2024, back in Hawaii for the first time since 2012.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2024 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a pin, a coin, a deck box, a playmat, a poster and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
